subject: Trading
title: Herd Mentality
description: A quick, practical guide to Herd Mentality.

hook.text: Everyone on social media is buying GameStop. You don't understand why. But you buy anyway. That's herding.

buildup.text: Herd mentality is the tendency to follow the crowd, assuming that many people can't all be wrong.

discovery.text: In markets, herding creates bubbles (everyone buying) and crashes (everyone selling) simultaneously.

twist.text: The crowd is often right during the middle of a trend—but catastrophically wrong at extremes.

climax.text: Independent thinking—having a thesis before seeing others' opinions—is the best defense against herding.

punchline.text: Think first, then check what others think.

quiz.question: When is herd mentality most dangerous?
